title: What If a Helicopter Flew on Mars? NASA's Flew 72 Times

scenes.text: What if you flew a helicopter on Mars? The air there is almost too thin to fly.
Mars air is only about one percent as dense as Earth's, so the blades must spin very fast.
In April 2021, NASA's Ingenuity made the first powered flight on another planet.
It was only meant to fly five times. It flew 72.
In nearly three years it logged more than 128 minutes in the air, about 11 miles, and rose as high as 79 feet.
A damaged blade ended it in 2024, but it proved that flying on Mars works.
